name: math.bits
doc:
math.bits (Go's math/bits): the single-value functions are C
externs over compiler builtins (runtime/src/std_math_bits.c); the
multi-word arithmetic with carries/borrows returns tuples:
`var (sum, carry) = bits.Add64(x, y, 0)`.

items.name: UintSize
items.doc: UintSize is the size of a uint in bits.
items.summary: UintSize is the size of a uint in bits.

items.name: Add32
items.signature: func Add32(x uint32, y uint32, carry uint32) (uint32, uint32)
items.doc: 32-bit variants.
items.summary: 32-bit variants.

items.name: Add64
items.signature: func Add64(x uint, y uint, carry uint) (uint, uint)
items.doc: x + y + carry (carry must be 0 or 1): (sum, carryOut).
items.summary: x + y + carry (carry must be 0 or 1): (sum, carryOut).

items.name: Div64
items.signature: func Div64(hi uint, lo uint, y uint) (uint, uint)
items.doc:
(hi, lo) / y: (quo, rem). Panics if y == 0 or y <= hi (the quotient
would overflow).
items.summary: (hi, lo) / y: (quo, rem).

items.name: LeadingZeros
items.doc: LeadingZeros returns the number of leading zero bits of x (64 for 0).
items.summary: LeadingZeros returns the number of leading zero bits of x (64 for 0).

items.name: Len

items.name: Len32

items.summary: Len32 returns the minimum number of bits to represent x (0 for 0).

items.summary: The 128-bit product x * y: (hi, lo).
